name: Kernel
tagline: you build agents. we give them the internet.
description: Kernel provides browsers-as-a-service: isolated cloud Chromium browsers with millisecond spin-up, session persistence, live view and replays, proxy and anti-bot handling, and managed authentication, so AI agents can use the web the way people do. Founded in 2025 by Catherine Jue and Rafael Garcia and based in San Francisco, it came out of Y Combinator's Summer 2025 batch and anchors its stack in open source, publishing unikernel-based Chromium images on GitHub. Kernel raised a $22 million seed and Series A led by Accel in October 2025.
